MDW-Bensenville Station Depot will be closed
MDW-Starting Saturday, August 1 through Tuesday, September 1, the Bensenville station depot will be closed for roof replacement. Please use caution near the work area during this time.

Milwaukee District North Major Track Project Affecting Midday Service Aug 3 - Oct 23

August 3 - October 23, track work to replace 4.5 miles of rail will affect midday service between Fox Lake and Lake Forest. Passengers boarding at these stations should utilize alternate Metra lines or other transportation. Visit metra.com for more info.

Milwaukee District North Line Midday Service Changes Begin August 3

Due to construction, inbound trains 2128 through 2142 will originate from Lake Forest, and outbound trains 2103 through 2119 will terminate at Lake Forest. Please visit Metra.com or MetraTracker.com to plan your alternate travel.

MDN - Morton Grove Station Construction

Platform construction will take place at the Morton Grove station beginning Monday, August 3 through Spring 2027. Please allow additional travel time and use caution near the work area during this time. Updates will be provided.

BNSF Harlem Avenue Station Closed Due to Construction from August 6 thru August 15
Beginning Thursday, August 6 through Saturday, August 15, the Harlem Avenue station will close due to road construction. Passengers must board trains at Berwyn or Riverside during this period.

ME Beginning May 18 South Water Elevator Will Be Closed

Starting May 18, the South Water elevator will be closed during reconstruction. ADA passengers should use Van Buren St or Museum Campus/11th St for elevator access. For the latest service alert info visit Metra.com/MEelevators.
